items.headline: Coal India dividend 2026 declared - Check amount; PSU quarterly profit up 57% - When is record date?
items.original: Coal India reported a 57% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to ₹6,547 crore in Q2FY27, while revenue grew 20.8% to ₹44,179 crore. The company declared a second interim dividend of ₹10.25 per share, with November 4, 2026, set as the record date.

items.headline: Milky Mist Q2 revenue surges 42% YoY, EBITDA soars 54%
items.original: Milky Mist Dairy Food recorded 41.6% year-on-year revenue growth in Q2 FY27, achieving record quarterly revenue and gross profit. Strong demand for value-added dairy, protein products and yoghurt drove growth, while first-half profit after tax surged 308.4%.
